code_hints: On navigation to PLP, first query and click #onetrust-accept-btn-handler if present, then wait 300-600ms before searching for product tiles.
If no [data-pid] tiles found, perform incremental scroll-to-bottom 2-3 times with 500ms waits; re-check selectors after each scroll.
Treat any element with [data-pid] as a tile root; prefer its closest anchor for PDP link. Fallback: first child anchor within the tile.
If a full-screen region/country selector appears, prefer clicking any link containing '/en-gb/' within the modal.
Set Accept-Language header to en-GB and keep the path fixed to /en-gb/ via the provided url_rules to avoid geo-redirect loops.
On PDP, try [itemprop='price'] first; if missing, check [data-testid='product-price'] and common .prices .price fallbacks.
rationale: PLP tiles likely failed to appear due to a cookie/consent overlay and region-based redirects. Adding OneTrust accept selector and enforcing en-gb via URL rewrite and Accept-Language reduces redirects. Moncler/SFCC often exposes product tiles via [data-pid]; we added robust fallback selectors and autoscroll to surface lazy-loaded tiles. PDP price/title fallbacks improve resilience once PDP links are followed.
